sectionSubtitle: // Things I've built or worked on

projects.name: AI4Bharat Website
projects.description: Interactive website for AI4Bharat, IIT Madras research lab building open-source AI for Indian languages, featuring live model demos.
projects.longDescription: Built the lab's public facing website using React.js and Django. Integrated similar components found under Dhruva Platform to allow public users to interact with our AI Models. Integrated different features such as API rate limiting, User Feedback and Data Logging to capture user interactions to better understand the public use of Indic Language Models.

projects.name: Dhruva Platform
projects.description: Dhruva is a full-fledged platform for serving AI models at scale. The platform is an inhouse application in order to deploy, serve and also manage access to different Indic Language Models
projects.longDescription: Built a responsive web Paltform with interactive UI components enabling users to interact with ML models across Transliteration, Machine Translation, ASR, TTS, and LLM categories. Implemented RESTful API integrations for real-time model inference and dynamic result rendering. Integrates with our backned API access control in order to generate and provision API Keys for Inference

projects.name: IndicLLMSuite
projects.description: IndicLLMSuite is the largest Pre-training and Instruction Fine-tuning dataset collection across 22 Indic languages. We open-source our pre-training dataset Sangraha, the Instruction Fine-tuning dataset IndicAlign-Instruct, and the Toxic alignment dataset IndicAlign-Toxic. We also open-source all the code and other resources used for curating these datasets, including Setu, a comprehensive data cleaning, filtering, and deduplication pipeline for Indic languages. We hope that this will advance the development of LLMs for Indian Languages.

projects.name: DGX - Scheduler
projects.description: This repository contains code for creating and setting up a queue based inference job scheduler for our internal DGX Servers. The main aim was to create a continuous system for running inference such as translation, transliteration, etc. of text data from Huggingface on our DGX systems while also allowing others to utilize the DGX resources. The Scheduler triggers each Job on the listed GPU ids and monitors it. If another GPU Process is trigggered the current job is killed and once the GPU is free it waits for n minutes before scheduling the job again.

projects.name: Setu: A Comprehensive Pipeline for Data Cleaning, Filtering and Deduplication
projects.description: Setu is a comprehensive pipeline designed to clean, filter, and deduplicate diverse data sources including Web, PDF, and Speech data. Built on Apache Spark, Setu encompasses four key stages: document preparation, document cleaning and analysis, flagging and filtering, and deduplication.

projects.name: Myna - A Browser Extension for Learning Indic Languages on the Go
projects.description: Myna is a Chrome Browser Extension that parses any web page on your browser and helps user translate/transliterate a highlighted word into any of the 22 Indic Languages. It also has a database that acts as a dictionary to aid the user in understanding a word.
